title: Otto and the Shy Moon
subtitle: A bedtime pop-up story
author: Storylight
blurb: A bedtime story that reads itself aloud, lights up every word, and pops out of the page when you touch it.

questions.q: Who is the main character of the story?
questions.right: Yes! Otto the little bear is the main character.
questions.wrong: Not quite. The owl and the cat are Otto's friends. The main character is Otto, the little bear.

questions.q: What did Otto hold to float up into the sky?
questions.right: That's right! Otto held his big red balloon tight and floated up, up, up.
questions.wrong: Hmm, not that one. Otto held his big red balloon, and it carried him up into the night.

questions.q: Who was hiding, shy, behind the clouds?
questions.right: Yes! The shy moon was hiding. Otto found her and brought her home.
questions.wrong: Not quite. It was the shy moon hiding behind the clouds. Otto said hello, and she smiled.

questions.q: Who told Otto to follow the stars?
questions.right: Yes! The owl said, "Follow the stars," and the stars made a path across the sky.
questions.wrong: Not quite. The cat said the moon was not there, and the moon was hiding. It was the owl who said to follow the stars.

questions.q: How did the moon help Otto get home?
questions.right: Yes! The moon glowed and lit Otto's way home, down past the stars.
questions.wrong: Not quite. The cloud yawned and the cat said meow. The moon glowed to light Otto's way home.
